company.name: elmenus
company.shortDescription: Elmenus is an online food discovery platform that provides its users with digitized restaurant menus from food carts to hotel restaurants.
company.description:
Elmenus is a venture-backed food discovery startup based in Egypt that serves over 1 Million monthly users. elmenus builds a platform that combines a social, visual, and personalized experience to help people discover and order the food they will love.

The company was established in 2011 and is based in Cairo, Egypt.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform providing users with access to digitized menus from over 6,000 restaurants, enabling food discovery and ordering.
